adequate_cases.name: maximum-256
adequate_cases.basis: 256 immutable Int leaves, 256 old-key callbacks returning their existing key, 256 bounded ASCII key validations/collision lookups, detached payloads, sorting and exact lineage. No recursive numerical proof or tessellation. Ordinary 100000 operations is a conservative finite-fixture allowance, not an exact measured count.

adequate_cases.name: panel-task-higher-budget
adequate_cases.basis: Two renamed String payloads in each of two occurrences, four 12-triangle panels plus one 12-triangle marker, one exact 89-byte 4×3 PNG, and five fixed poses over one second. Explicit 400000/80000 authority is requested and independently host-authorized before candidate execution; no candidate measurement sets this bound.
